title: 2026 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter global buyer guide: diesel, gasoline history and eSprinter kept separate
text: Market-bounded commercial-van research 2026 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter global buyer guide: diesel, gasoline history and eSprinter kept separate A procurement-focused Sprinter reference that binds every engine, body, weight, range and safety claim to its source market, model year and configuration. Vauxford · CC BY-SA 4.0 By AutoBridge Export Editorial Team Review Automated quality checks completed · 2026-08-15 Method Document research and vehicle comparison Evidence Documented public and primary sources; no first-hand claim AI assisted research organization, drafting or translation; sources and claims remain subject to the stated review process. AI policy · Source methodology Start with identity, not the 2026 search label Mercedes-Benz sells Sprinter as a configurable commercial-vehicle family: cargo or panel van, crew or passenger body, and cab chassis, with several lengths, roof heights and gross-weight classes. eSprinter adds a battery-electric branch. A listing that says only ‘2026 Sprinter’ therefore leaves the decisive facts unresolved. Before pricing, record the VIN, production month, sales market, manufacturer body code, wheelbase, roof, axle ratings, original seating and the completed body's legal classification. The sources accessed on 28 July 2026 describe different slices of that family. The US page explicitly labels its current Cargo Van lineup 2026; the Mexican page describes model year 2025; UK and Australian pages describe their current local ranges without making every figure a universal model-year promise. This guide preserves those labels. A newer registration date, a familiar badge or a seller's translated advertisement cannot move a specification from one market to another. Separate diesel, historical gasoline and battery electric hardware For the US 2026 Cargo Van, the verified combustion anchor is the 1,950 cc four-cylinder diesel. Standard output is 170 hp and 295 lb-ft; high output is 211 hp and 332 lb-ft, with 9G-TRONIC. Rear-wheel drive and available all-wheel-drive combinations vary by derivative, so an output figure does not prove the driven axles. Ask for the factory data card and emissions label, then confirm that engine, transmission and drive entries agree with the VIN before ordering parts or estimating fuel cost. The 2.0 L turbo gasoline figure of 188 hp and 258 lb-ft belongs to Mercedes-Benz Vans USA's model-year-2022 brochure. It is useful for identifying older stock, but it is not evidence that a US 2026 vehicle is gasoline-powered. eSprinter is different again: no combustion engine, diesel tank or gasoline emissions system should appear in its specification. The US electric page lists rear-wheel drive, 100 or 150 kW motor and 81 or 113 kWh usable battery. Keep length, roof and payload on the same configuration row A clean US example shows why configuration binding matters. The 2026 WORKER Cargo Van 2500 with 144-inch wheelbase and standard roof is listed at 234 inches long and 100 inches high, with 4,211 lb payload, 319.0 cu ft cargo volume, 9,050 lb GVWR and 5,000 lb maximum towing. Those values form one row. The US page also contains longer, higher and heavier derivatives with different payload, volume and towing figures; taking the best number from each row would describe a van that does not exist. Metric-market maxima are equally local. The UK combustion panel van offers 5,930, 6,970 or 7,370 mm lengths, two heights, floor length up to 4,810 mm and payload up to 2,479 kg at up to 5,000 kg GVW. Australia publishes floor length up to 4.81 m, payload up to 3,090 kg and GVM up to 5,500 kg. Mexico's model-year-2025 page lists up to 15.5 m3 and 3,068 kg. Different homologation ranges explain the differences; none should overwrite a vehicle's plates. Read eSprinter range and charging in their test context The US eSprinter page pairs the 81 and 113 kWh usable batteries with stated maximum ranges of 150 and 206 miles. It also lists 144- or 170-inch wheelbase, 239.7- to 280-inch overall length, 319.0-488.1 cu ft cargo volume and a 9,370 lb GVWR. The published AC and DC times depend on battery and charging power, including 9.6 kW AC and up to 110 kW DC examples. A buyer should capture the battery code, onboard charger, inlet type and charging curve for the exact van. The UK eSprinter page uses combined WLTP and states 161-272 miles (259-438 km) for 81-113 kWh, together with 5,900 or 7,000 mm lengths, normal or high roof, up to 4,400 mm load floor, 14 m3 load volume, 4,250 kg gross mass and 2,000 kg towing. Do not compare the UK range endpoints directly with the US numbers as though they came from one test. Route payload, temperature, speed, auxiliary loads and charger reliability need a local duty-cycle trial. Interpret safety grades and recalls precisely Euro NCAP gives the listed European N1 diesel Sprinter five stars under its 2025 commercial-van assessment, with 75% for Safe Driving, 89% for Crash Avoidance and 80% for Post Crash Safety. ANCAP separately gives applicable Australian Sprinter petrol/diesel vehicles and eSprinter electric vehicles a 2024 Platinum commercial-van grading at 89%. ANCAP explains that this comparison concentrates on collision-avoidance systems and does not replace its destructive-crash star programme. Build date, fitted sensors and protocol must accompany any rating claim. Recalls are narrower than a model name. NHTSA campaign 25V712 concerns 16 US model-year-2025 Sprinter 2500 vehicles with a radar-board risk; Transport Canada 2025076 concerns certain model-year-2024 eSprinters with a rear-axle electric-drivetrain weld issue. Neither notice proves that another VIN is affected or clear. Run current government and manufacturer VIN searches immediately before payment and again before shipment, then obtain invoices showing that every open remedy was completed. Build a landed-cost and compliance file before purchase For a combustion Sprinter, collect the VIN data card, title, production label, engine family, emissions label, axle and gross-weight plates, service history, recall clearance and conversion approval. Verify diesel after-treatment, fuel quality compatibility, steering side, lamps, speedometer units, tachograph or speed-limiter duties, licence class and local inspection rules. Weigh the finished van by axle with its permanent shelving, refrigeration, lift, seats and spare wheel; brochure payload is not remaining legal payload after conversion. For eSprinter, add battery capacity and health evidence, high-voltage warranty start date, charging inlet and onboard-charger codes, DC charge capability, thermal-management diagnostics and destination charging support. Quote freight from actual overall length and height, not the shortest brochure body. The purchase decision should compare usable payload, route energy or fuel, insurance, tyres, scheduled maintenance, charging downtime, emissions-system risk, parts lead time and resale eligibility under one clearly identified configuration. Frequently asked questions Is a 2026 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter available with gasoline? The verified US 2026 Cargo Van page in this evidence set lists the 1,950 cc diesel. The 188 hp 2.0 L turbo gasoline specification is from an official model-year-2022 brochure and must be treated as historical. Require a 2026 factory build sheet and VIN data card before calling any current vehicle gasoline-powered. Can I use the 4,211 lb payload for every Sprinter? No. It belongs to the US 2026 WORKER Cargo Van 2500 with 144-inch wheelbase and standard roof in the cited row. Longer, higher, heavier, AWD, passenger, crew, chassis and converted vehicles have different curb mass, axle limits and legal payload, so the finished vehicle must be weighed. Are the US and UK eSprinter range figures directly comparable? No. The US page states 150 or 206 miles for its 81 or 113 kWh versions, while the UK page states 161-272 miles under combined WLTP. Keep the source test method, battery, body and options with each number, then validate the proposed route under local load, weather and charging conditions. Does five-star Euro NCAP or Platinum ANCAP cover every imported Sprinter? No. Euro NCAP's 2025 result is tied to its listed European N1 diesel test scope, while ANCAP's 2024 Platinum grades apply to defined Australian combustion and electric variants and focus on collision avoidance. Confirm build date, market, sensors and standard equipment for the exact VIN. What should be checked before paying for an export Sprinter? Match the VIN, build sheet, title, production and emissions labels, body and conversion approvals, axle/GVW plates, exact dimensions, finished axle weights and recall status. For diesel verify after-treatment support; for eSprinter also verify battery code, health, warranty, inlet, onboard charger and local DC compatibility. title: MG4 EV 2026: a market-matched battery, range and safety guide
text: Configuration-first electric hatchback research MG4 EV 2026: a market-matched battery, range and safety guide The MG4 name now covers materially different cars and specifications. This guide anchors every major number to a country, version, test method and date so a buyer can verify the actual vehicle instead of shopping from a blended global specification. © M 93 · CC BY-SA 3.0 de By AutoBridge Export Editorial Team Review Human review recorded · 2026-08-20 Method Document research and vehicle comparison Evidence Documented public and primary sources; no first-hand claim AI assisted research organization, drafting or translation; sources and claims remain subject to the stated review process. AI policy · Source methodology Start with identity, not the badge A search for a “2026 MG4” can lead to at least two distinct vehicles and several country catalogues. The refreshed MG4 EV keeps the 4,287 mm MSP-platform body and, in France, uses rear-wheel drive for Premium 64 and Premium 77 or dual-motor all-wheel drive for XPOWER. The MG4 EV Urban is a different, 4,395 mm E3-platform front-wheel-drive hatchback sold in Australia with 43 or 54 kWh batteries. Before comparing price, record the VIN, production month, destination market, exact trim, driven wheels and battery label from the vehicle and its conformity documents. A listing that says only “MG4 2026” is not specific enough to support a battery, range, charging or safety claim. Battery capacity needs a definition MG Motor France's March 2026 sheet calls Premium 64 a 64 kWh gross LFP pack, Premium 77 a 77 kWh gross NMC pack and XPOWER a 64 kWh gross NMC pack. Those are not interchangeable chemistries or drivetrains. They also should not be mixed with Green NCAP's 2024 Comfort test, which recorded a manufacturer-declared usable capacity of 61.7 kWh and independently measured 63.2 kWh usable. Gross nameplate capacity, declared usable energy and test-measured usable energy answer different questions. Ask the seller for the market specification sheet and battery diagnostic report, and write each number with its definition rather than presenting “64 kWh” as a universal pack. Range figures belong to a cycle and version For the refreshed French MY2026 range, MG publishes 452 km WLTP combined for Premium 64, 545 km for Premium 77 and 405 km for XPOWER. Poland's April 2026 catalogue lists another version matrix, including 49 kWh cars and WLTP values from 330 to 530 km, so even nearby European markets cannot safely share one table. Green NCAP is a separate independent test programme: its older Comfort RWD car used 16.4 kWh/100 km in the warm laboratory test, 17.6 in the cold-start test, 26.2 on its highway cycle and 34.9 at −7°C. Those results explain weather and speed sensitivity but must never be relabelled as WLTP or as a 2026 range. Charging is a matrix, not one headline The French MY2026 technical sheet gives all three versions an 11 kW AC onboard charger, but their DC peaks and claimed 10–80% times differ: Premium 64 is 154 kW and 25 minutes, Premium 77 is 144 kW and 40 minutes, and XPOWER is 140 kW and 30 minutes. The lower peak yet longer 77 kWh result is not a contradiction; pack size, chemistry and charge curve matter more than one maximum. Poland lists 6.6 or 11 kW AC and 88, 140 or 144 kW DC depending on version. Confirm connector standard, AC phase support, battery preconditioning, heat pump and the exact state-of-charge window for the destination car before modelling journey time. Read safety ratings by applicability Euro NCAP's original 2022 MG 4 Electric assessment reports 83% adult occupant, 80% child occupant, 75% vulnerable-road-user and 78% safety-assist scores, with its validity table describing a 4x2 car. ANCAP's related result applies only to 2WD variants built from March 2023 and expires in December 2028; it reports 83%, 86%, 75% and 81% under its published scoring. That evidence should not be stretched to XPOWER AWD. Urban has separate 2025 Euro NCAP and ANCAP assessments, its own AH4E series identity and different scores. Match the exact variant and build date to the rating page, then inspect airbags, driver-assistance equipment, tyres and repair history on the actual car. Finish with VIN, approval and ownership checks A cross-border purchase is not complete when the brochure numbers match. Use the destination government's recall service with the registration or VIN and obtain written evidence that applicable campaigns are closed; the UK DVSA gateway explicitly supports registration or make-model-year checks. For Australia, confirm that the individual vehicle is entered on the Register of Approved Vehicles under the relevant approval pathway, because a foreign specification does not establish Australian compliance. Also verify battery state of health, high-voltage warranty transfer, service history, charging cables, navigation and app region, cellular connectivity, parts support, tax treatment and insurance. Put unresolved items in the contract rather than assuming the MG badge makes them global. Frequently asked questions Is every 2026 MG4 EV fitted with a 64 kWh battery? No. France lists 64 kWh Premium, 77 kWh Premium and 64 kWh XPOWER, Poland lists additional 49 kWh variants, and the separate Australian MG4 EV Urban uses 43 or 54 kWh packs. Match country, trim and VIN. Is the 545 km figure a real-world guarantee? No. It is the French Premium 77 WLTP combined certification value. Temperature, speed, elevation, load, tyres, heating and battery condition change road range, and another market's 77 kWh version may carry a different figure. Which version charges fastest? In the French MY2026 table, Premium 64 has the highest stated DC peak and shortest 10–80% claim at 154 kW and 25 minutes. Premium 77 is 144 kW and 40 minutes; XPOWER is 140 kW and 30 minutes under suitable conditions. Does the five-star rating cover XPOWER and Urban? Do not assume so. The original Euro NCAP validity table is 4x2 and ANCAP explicitly limits the original MG 4 Electric rating to 2WD. Urban has separate 2025 assessments; XPOWER AWD needs configuration-specific confirmation. What documents should an importer request before payment? Request the VIN and build plate, market specification and conformity papers, government approval or registration evidence, current recall clearance, battery-health report, service record, warranty-transfer terms and proof that local charging and connected services work.
